body: Sunday after supper: two workers from the greenhouse trial carried a bitter residue. my hands blistered before the phones went dead.
title: Sunday after supper — a bitter residue
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same a bitter residue while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.

body:
We put the guests names on a sheet so we could keep the surprise. A stranger arrived with a copy that had two names removed.

He asked whether those two had already left. I said one was still upstairs, getting ready. He folded his copy and waited at the foot of the stairs.

Nobody wanted to spoil the party by arguing. I have kept our list because it is the only one with everyone on it.
title: The list for the party
gloss: An altered count or retained object was left at the scene.
rival_reading: A response to an agricultural exposure could explain the same record or object.
